# Mesa Wren Landscape Co. - Extended AI Reference

## Business Summary
Mesa Wren Landscape Co. is a Scottsdale-based residential landscaping and outdoor living company serving homeowners across Scottsdale, Paradise Valley, Phoenix, and nearby East Valley communities. Best fit for homeowners who want design-build planning, premium hardscape and outdoor living upgrades, desert-climate durability, and a clear project review path.
